set.description: 能认、读、写万以内的数，知道千位、百位、十位、个位。
set.name: Understanding Numbers up to 10000

criteria: 能判断情形是否要分类相加
能计算互斥类别的办法总数
set.description: 完成一件事有若干类办法，类与类互斥，总办法数等于各类办法数相加。
set.name: Addition Principle of Counting

criteria: 能判断情形是否要分步相乘
能计算各步办法数的乘积
set.description: 完成一件事要依次做若干步，每步的办法数相乘就是总办法数。
set.name: Multiplication Principle of Counting

criteria: 能在有限全集中列出补集
能用全集个数减去集合个数求补集个数
set.description: 在给定全集中会求补集，知道补集与原集合没有公共元素、并且合并后是全集。
set.name: Complement

criteria: 能计算排列数
能说出排列数公式的含义
set.description: 排列数 A(n,k)=n!/(n−k)!，也就是从 n 起连乘 k 个递减的正整数。
set.name: Formula for the number of permutations

criteria: 能判断实际问题用组合而不是排列
能计算分类选取的组合数
set.description: 选人、选物且不计顺序时用组合；若还要按类别分别选取，再把组合数相乘。
set.name: Simple Applications of Combinations

criteria: 能找出一个不太大的数的全部因数
能说出谁是谁的倍数
set.description: 知道因数和倍数是相互依存的，会找一个数的因数和 100 以内的倍数。
set.name: Factors and multiples

criteria: 能从几十数到 100
能说出一个两位数由几个十和几个一组成
set.description: 能数、读、写 100 以内的数，知道数的组成。
set.name: Understanding numbers within 100

criteria: 能列出所有等可能结果
能求概率
set.description: 列出所有等可能结果，数出符合条件的结果数求概率。
set.name: Finding Probability by Enumeration

set.reason: Outcome enumeration provides concrete practice partitioning and counting finite outcomes. Probability ratios are unnecessary, as Gemini notes, but that does not erase the useful enumeration component.
Contrasting disjoint alternatives with sequential choices helps choose an operation. An array of shirts and trousers establishes the product principle independently of the addition rule.
The combined counting criterion contains multiplicative stages within classified cases; the stage-wise multiplication principle is directly used in those parts.
Reading thousands/hundreds/tens/ones numbers contains the lower tens-and-ones meanings within each number.
Testing whether a number is a multiple of two or five requires the multiple/divisibility relation being tested.

criteria: 能在同一问题里分别使用加法和乘法
能按步骤写出算式
set.description: 一件事里既有分类又有分步时，先分清哪一段相加、哪一段相乘，再合并。
set.name: Combined Counting Using Addition and Multiplication

criteria: 能根据个位判断是不是 2 的倍数
能根据个位判断是不是 5 的倍数
set.description: 知道个位是 0、2、4、6、8 的数是 2 的倍数，个位是 0 或 5 的数是 5 的倍数。
set.name: Characteristics of multiples of 2 and 5
